principle: Official issuer offer documents and SEBI / exchange filings are the source of truth. If sources conflict, retain both and explain the difference. Link to official documents; do not re-host or systematically reproduce exchange content without permission.

access_controls.nse_automation: Disabled. NSE Terms of Use prohibit systematic or automated collection including scraping, data mining, extraction and harvesting. Written permission and legal review required before automation.
access_controls.bse_automation: Disabled. BSE-specific terms and permissions for the relevant pages must be checked before automation.
access_controls.sebi_automation: No scraping assumed. Use official published downloads / links and review terms before automation.
access_controls.rehosting: Link to source documents; do not mirror PDFs unless the licence clearly permits it.
access_controls.api_feeds: Enable only after documented permission, a data licence, usage limits, contract and audit trail.
